title: Free support of the first compatible term
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a finite DNF formula on $n$ coordinates, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction for which the restricted formula takes different values on some two binary assignments to the free coordinates. The free support of the first compatible term is the set of coordinates that are both free under $\rho$ and occur in the term at the least index whose term is compatible with $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: the restriction is bad for the formula
